name: Cat and Room
source:
You picked up the mysterious cat Haru a month ago
who had mysterious powers.

One time a day, it will grant you a small wish.

You decided to ask Haru to attract the lady in your apartment complex but...

一個月前，你撿到了一隻神秘的貓Haru。

它擁有神秘力量，每天可以實現一個小願望。

你決定請求Haru吸引公寓裡的那位女士，可是……
